 Through: Mr. Ajay Bakshi, Advocate
 Vs

Through: Mr. P. D. Singh, Dy. Ag for R-1.

Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Mohd. Yousuf Wani, Judge
 Order
All the petitioners and respondent No.2/complainant are also present in person.

2. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioners that the private parties, i.e. the petitioners/accused and the respondent No.2/complainant, have already settled the matrimonial dispute that had led to the registration of the impugned case FIR bearing No.0035/2021 dated 18.07.2021.07.2021 with the Police Station Womens Cell, Jammu under Sections 498A, 109 IPC.
It is submitted by the learned counsel that the petitioners are the in- laws of the respondent No.2/complainant.

3. The learned counsel submitted that two more quashment petitions bearing CRM(M)
No.480/2022 and CRM(M) No.863/2021 are also pending in this Court out of which one petition seeks the quashment of the same FIR bearing No.0035/2021 of Police Station, Womens Cell,
Jammu when the other petition seeks the quashment of a private complaint also filed by the present respondent No.2 against the present petitioners, which are listed for hearing on 11.02.2026 and 16.02.2026.

It is submitted by the learned counsel that all the three petitions be directed to be listed before the Court on 10.12.2025 so that the private parties may get their statements recorded in all the three petitions in attestation of the mutual compromise.
The learned counsel for the petitioners furnished in the open Court, a copy of the civil miscellaneous application accompanied with mutual settlement between the parties.
Same is taken on record and shall be made a part of physical as well as digital file.
4. Registry is directed to list all the three petitions for hearing on 10.12.2025.
